It can be made into ten Beaver scrolls (Multichop) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 0.7 experience.

Players can buy the beer from Thora the Barkeep in the Rellekka Long Hall Bar for 26 coins (requires completion of the quest The Fremennik Trials), or take the tankard which respawns within the longhall.

It is created by casting the Lvl-6 Enchant spell on an onyx necklace. It will grant a higher maximum hit than an Essence of Finality (or) with any of the obsidian melee weapons, however the loss of finality's passives and ability to use special attacks may make it not worth using.

It is an ingredient in Bog 'n' Hog stew, which requires level 75 Cooking and learn how to make it from Waterface in Linbog Village.

The soft clay is used to make pottery and urns in Crafting, furniture in Construction, and magic tablets.

Coal is a resource that can be obtained through mining coal rocks or concentrated coal rocks, requiring level 20 Mining, in various places around RuneScape. One of the best places to mine coal rocks is Gunnarsgrunn mine while concentrated coal is only found in the Living Rock Caverns. Coal can be obtained through Managing Miscellania by having the player's subjects of Miscellania gather it for them.
lead
A coal stone spirit is an item that allows the player to receive an additional coal when mining coal rocks or concentrated coal deposits.
lead
Cobalt blue is an Archaeological material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 48 Archaeology, at various dig sites around RuneScape.
lead

A cobalt chinchompa (unchecked) is the unchecked version of a cobalt chinchompa from the player-owned farm. Like all chinchompas, protean traps do not have a chance to give players a farm animal variant of the chinchompa.
lead
Cobalt skillchompas are a special type of weapon obtained by catching cobalt skillchompas at the Tree Gnome Stronghold Hunter area north of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
lead

The cockatrice egg is a tertiary drop from the cockatrice, and can also be looted from a spirit impling or the jarred version. Alternately, it can be created from an ordinary chicken egg by casting Ophidian incubation, the special attack of the spirit cobra.
lead

A cockatrice head is a very rare drop from cockatrices, which require level 25 Slayer to kill. If players wish to make a minitrice pet, they must take it, either stuffed or unstuffed, to the Nomad at Soul Wars who will take it and 25 zeal points away from them and give them a minitrice which will go into the pet interface like most other pets.
lead
A stuffed cockatrice head is the result of taking a cockatrice head to the Taxidermist in Canifis. She charges 2,000 coins for the stuffing service, and it cannot be undone.
lead

The cocktail guide (or The Blurberry Cocktail Guide) contains a collection of recipes for the various gnome cocktails. It is useful for the Gnome Restaurant minigame, or players who just want to make the cocktails for themselves. Player may obtain the book from Blurberry, Heckel Funch, Rasolo, killing gnome women, or from the bookcase in a player-owned house.
lead

Cocktail shakers are used to make gnome drinks. The shakers can be bought from Heckel Funch for 2 coins, but it is advisable that it is bought from Hudo, or just picked up from the table near him. Cocktail shakers can also be bought from a Bartender in the Grand Tree for 20 coins when talking to one of them.
lead

A coconut is a fruit harvested from a palm tree grown from a palm tree seed in a fruit tree patch, requiring level 68 Farming. Up to six coconuts can be harvested from a palm tree at a time.

An open coconut is the open seed of a palm tree containing milk. Players can use the coconut on an empty vial to create coconut milk and a coconut shell.

Cod is a members-only fish that can be made by cooking a raw cod with level 18 Cooking. It will restore 450 life points.

rows.h2: 40 mithril seeds can be obtained as a reward from the Waterfall Quest. Players can also purchase up to 500 of them at Legends' Guild, which slowly restocks over time.

rows: A mithril spear is a two-handed melee weapon. During Tai Bwo Wannai Trio, the mithril spear may be used with poison karambwan paste to create the mithril spear (kp). After the quest, the poisoned spear can be bought from Tamayu's Spear Stall and cleaned with a cleaning cloth to get a mithril spear.

The modified farmer's hat is made by using a farmer's hat on a farmer's hat add-on. In addition to granting a 1% Farming experience bonus, players can teleport to the allotment patch in Morytania three times a day, or to Taverley if they do not have access to Morytania.

The mole claw is a drop received from the giant mole found in the Falador Mole Lair underneath Falador Park, as well as from molanisks and Experiment No.2. Like the mole skin, it can be given to Wyson the gardener in Falador Park in exchange for bird's nests. Unlike other bird's nests, the bird's nests obtained by this method never contain rings or eggs.
lead
A mole nose is a drop from the giant mole that will only appear with completion of all of the elite Falador achievements, and owning a Falador shield 4.
lead

Mole skins are dropped by the giant mole found in the Falador Mole Lair underneath Falador Park. Like the mole claw, they can be traded to Wyson the Gardener for bird's nests. Although mole skins are dropped in free-to-play, they cannot be traded to Wyson.

The Molten Barricade cosmetic ability scroll is a reward that could be obtained from Academy of Heroes, a Treasure Hunter promotion. It can be read to unlock the Molten Barricade ability override for the Barricade ability, destroying the scroll in the process after a confirmation prompt.

Molten glass is mostly used in the Crafting and Construction skills. Molten glass can be created through the cast-item portion of a furnace using the Crafting skill, a bucket of sand and soda ash, granting 20 Crafting experience. Fritz the Glassblower on Entrana will teach the players how to make molten glass, but the players do not need to speak with him in order to make it.

The molten shard is used to make the artisan's cape and artisan's helm. They are occasionally obtained by players with 99 Smithing when training Smithing. If you do not have space in the backpack, you'll get the message: "You found a shard emanating magical energy as you were training, but there was no space in your inventory to take it." Once there is a free space, the shard will be obtained.

A monkey is used in the Trouble Brewing minigame to gather bitternuts. They are found in the island in between the two bases, and they can be caught.

rows: Monkfish are members-only food that heal 1,600 life points. At level 65 Divination, members can weave 45 vibrant energy with one monkfish to create a portent of restoration VII or an attuned portent of restoration VII at 67 Divination, which heal 1,200 or 1,600 life points respectively. Monkfish can be caught in the Piscatoris Fishing Colony with a small fishing net; accessing the colony requires players to have completed Swan Song.

A moonstone is a gemstone used in Crafting. It can be crafted from an uncut moonstone by a player with level 67 Crafting, yielding 167.5 Crafting experience. Uncut moonstones can be obtained randomly as a reward from ritual disturbances, by catching ghost implings without impling jars, by looting ghost impling jars, or from Thalmund's Wares.

Moonstone Circlet is a head slot cosmetic override automatically obtained by owning the dragonstone, onyx and hydrix circlet overrides.
lead

A moonstone amulet is an unstrung variant of a strung moonstone amulet. It is made from an ensouled bar and a cut moonstone at a furnace using an amulet mould, requiring level 85 Crafting. Additionally, the ability to make moonstone jewellery must have been learnt from the Former Master Crafter in the City of Um by completing the Mystical Moonstone achievement.

A moonstone bone dart is an item that acts as a ranged weapon in the Maize Maze during Harvest Hollow, although it cannot be wielded like a normal weapon. It is obtained by catching ghost implings that always give a moonstone bone dart.
lead

A moonstone bracelet is a piece of moonstone jewellery that may be equipped in the gloves slot. To be able to craft the bracelet, the ability to make moonstone jewellery must be learnt from the Former Master Crafter in the City of Um by completing the Mystical Moonstone achievement. It may be crafted at a furnace from an ensouled bar and moonstone with level 79 Crafting.

Moonstone dust is a possible item reward from The Gate of Elidinis or pickpocketing fairy traders. It can be transmuted into an uncut moonstone using the Divination skill.
lead

A moonstone necklace is a piece of moonstone jewellery that may be equipped in the neck slot. To be able to craft the necklace, the ability to make moonstone jewellery must have been learnt from the Former Master Crafter in the City of Um by completing the Mystical Moonstone achievement. It may be crafted at a furnace from an ensouled bar and moonstone, requiring level 77 Crafting.

A moonstone ring is a piece of moonstone jewellery that may be equipped in the ring slot. To be able to craft the ring, the ability to make moonstone jewellery must have been learnt from the Former Master Crafter in the City of Um, completing the Mystical Moonstone achievement. It may be crafted at a furnace from an ensouled bar and moonstone with level 67 Crafting.

Morchella mushroom spores can be obtained as a reward from Evil Trees, bird's nests, Zanarian zygomites, or looted from the Zanaris Market seed stall. They are also dropped by an array of monsters and can be obtained from Treasure Trails.

Mort myre fungi are mushrooms native to the Mort Myre Swamp in Morytania. They can be obtained by casting bloom with either a blessed silver sickle or an Ivandis flail near some dead logs, which may or may not grow the fungi. They can also be obtained by killing monsters or as produce from certain zygomite breeds at the player-owned farm.
lead

A Mort myre pear is a fruit used to fill druid pouches. During A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains it is possible that Malignius Mortifer requires the player to get a mort myre pear, alongside 2 other items.
lead

Mort myre stems can be obtained by operating a silver sickle (b) near a rotting branch on the ground in Mort Myre. After having done the Legacy of Seergaze quest, the player can also operate the Ivandis flail near branches in Mort Myre to get these stems.
lead

Mortar Board is a cosmetic override for the head slot obtained by gaining 50 training points in the boss assistance rewards system. Each training point is awarded to a player who has 10 or more kills at a boss where one to fourteen other players have fewer than 10 kills.
lead

Morty is the skilling pet for Constitution. It is unlocked by inspecting the Morty pet, found while training Constitution. Once this pet is unlocked, its appearance can be changed with a Morty Halo appearance token or Morty Bunny appearance token.
lead
The Morty Bunny appearance token is a token unlock item that can be randomly obtained by redeeming a Skill Pet Bunny appearance token or by opening a mystery egg.
lead

The Morty pet is an item that can be found while training Constitution. It can be inspected to unlock the Morty pet, completing the Constitution - Morty achievement as well as triggering the message Congratulations! When a player obtains the pet and does not have space in their inventory and their bank is full as well, it is attempted to be given again once the player has space in their inventory.

Morwenna's headdress is a headdress obtained from Gudrik in Port Sarim. It could previously be obtained by defeating Morwenna the Cruel during the Ashdale Tutorial. After completion of Call of the Ancestors, Tunks can be found wearing this headdress, suggesting that he too completed the tutorial.
lead
A Morytanian music box is an item that can be reclaimed for free from Diango. It may not be placed too close to a Divination harvesting spot.
lead

A moss titan pouch is a summoning pouch used to summon a moss titan. It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 202 spirit shards, a blue charm, and an earth talisman in the backpack, requiring 79 Summoning and giving 695.2 experience. It can be made into ten Elemental Titan scrolls (Titan's Constitution) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 7.9 experience.

Mossy peat is a type of soil that is found while excavating at the Moonrise Dig Site, which requires at least level 52 Archaeology. It can be screened with level 52 Archaeology at the screening station at the Archaeology Campus to obtain materials and rarely artefacts from the soil.

A mourning lily is an ingredient used to make extreme antisanguine potions at level 85 Herblore. Players may harvest mourning lilies from a mourning lily seed planted in a nightshade patch, requiring level 96 Farming.

lead
A mud pie is an equipable item that can be worn in a player's main hand slot. The mud pie can be obtained as a rare drop from looting baby implings, or made using the Cooking skill at level 29.

Mud runes are combination runes. They count as two separate runes: one water rune and one earth rune.

The Mudborne staff is a tier 78 two-handed magic weapon. It is made by upgrading an earthborne staff with a fen-orb and 5,000 water runes with level 52 Runecrafting.

The muddy key is a key that is used to open the muddy chest in the Lava Maze. This key functions very similarly to the crystal key that is available for members, though it is much more dangerous to use due to the presence of high-level monsters. With the removal of Chaos dwarves from the Wilderness on 1 August 2022, free players can only obtain a muddy key by purchasing it from the Grand Exchange.

Mulled wine could be obtained by opening a Festive cracker or by buying them from Diango during the 2013 Christmas event. The wine could also be given to Sir Amik Varze, who was drunkenly stumbling around the Lumbridge crater and would call out to players to share a drink with him. It could once again be obtained during the 2016 or 2017 Clue Scroll Winter Weekends as a possible reward from festive boxes.

If a pure essence is attached, it becomes a Plain runecrafting urn (empty), giving 1 Runecrafting experience, and can no longer be traded.
lead
A plain satchel is a drop from frogeels in the Creature Creation activity. Other colours of satchels are available from the Creature Creation minigame.
lead

A plain smithing urn (no rune) is an item used to make a plain smithing urn. It is made by firing a plain smithing urn (unfired) in a pottery oven or at a portable crafter, requiring level 35 Crafting and giving 42 Crafting experience. If a fire rune is attached, it becomes a plain smithing urn (empty), giving 1 Smithing experience, and can no longer be traded.
lead
Plain whirligig shells are obtained when hunting plain whirligigs inside Het's Oasis. No flower is required to attract them.
lead

The plain woodcutting urn (no rune) is an item used to make a plain woodcutting urn. It is made by firing a plain woodcutting urn (unf) in a pottery oven or at a portable crafter, requiring level 44 Crafting and giving 48 Crafting experience. If an earth rune is attached, it becomes a Plain woodcutting urn (empty), giving 1 Woodcutting experience, and can no longer be traded.
lead
A plank is the lowest level Construction item and is used in several quests. It is made of regular logs. It is the only type of plank available for free-to-play players.
lead

dr: Construction supplies (There's No Place Like Home...)

rows: A plant cure is a potion that players can use on diseased plants while farming. It can be bought for 40 coins from a farming shop.
lead

Plant pots are used in the Farming skill to turn tree seeds, fruit tree seeds, calquat tree seeds and spirit tree seeds into seedlings. With the appropriate Farming level and a gardening trowel in their inventory, a player can create a seedling by using a tree seed on a filled plant pot. They may also be obtained on the Grand Exchange, although this may take some time, due to the buying limit.
lead

Empty plant pots are items used for Farming. An empty plant pot may be created with the Crafting skill at level 19 by using a soft clay on a potter's wheel, which creates an unfired plant pot. With filled plant pots available from farming shops for the same price as empty plant pots, most players simply discard empties on use.
lead

The platebody (class 1) is equipment that can only be worn in Stealing Creation. It can be made using a creation kiln with a class 1 sacred clay and 1 Smithing. Like all sacred clay items, it can be traded freely between players who are on the same team during the minigame.
lead
The platebody (class 2) is from the Stealing Creation minigame. It is made by using class 2 sacred clay on a creation kiln. It requires 20 Defence to wear and 20 Smithing to make.
lead
The platebody (class 3) is from the Stealing Creation minigame. It is made by using class 3 sacred clay on a creation kiln. It requires 40 Defence to wear, and requires 40 Smithing to create.
lead

The platebody (class 4) is from the Stealing Creation minigame and can be made by using class 4 sacred clay on a creation kiln. The class of the platebody is dependent on the class of the clay used to create it. It requires 60 Defence to wear and 60 Smithing to make it.
lead

The platebody (class 5) from the Stealing Creation minigame is made by using class 5 sacred clay on a creation kiln with 80 Smithing. Like all sacred clay items, it can be traded freely between players who are on the same team during the minigame.
lead

A platinum amulet is a piece of platinum jewellery created by stringing an unstrung platinum amulet. It can be enchanted using Lvl-5 Enchant to create an amulet of the expert, an amulet that will consume charges to grant 20% extra progress while smithing, fletching, runecrafting, or crafting certain types of equipment.
lead

An unstrung platinum amulet is a piece of platinum jewellery made by using a platinum bar on a furnace with a cut dragonstone in the backpack. Level 108 Crafting is required to make one, and doing so grants 248 experience.
lead
A platinum anklet is a piece of platinum jewellery made by crafting a platinum bar and a dragonstone with level 109 Crafting at any furnace.
lead
A platinum bar is a refined bar of platinum created through the Smithing skill by smelting platinum ore in a furnace. Platinum bars are used to create platinum jewellery with the Crafting skill.
lead
A platinum bracelet is a piece of platinum jewellery. It can be enchanted using the Lvl-5 Enchant spell or tablet to make a sunburst bracelet.
lead
A platinum necklace is a piece of jewellery made by crafting a platinum bar and a dragonstone at level 105 Crafting at any furnace.
lead

Platinum ore is an ore that can be obtained by mining platinum rocks, requiring level 104 Mining. Platinum ore is used to create platinum bars at a furnace, which are required to craft platinum jewellery and the masterwork magic equipment.
lead

A platinum ring is a piece of platinum jewellery released with the 2025 Crafting update. It is made by using a platinum bar, a dragonstone and a ring mould at a furnace, requiring level 104 Crafting. It may be enchanted with Lvl-5 Enchant to make a ring of retribution.
lead
A platinum stone spirit is an item that allows the player to receive an additional platinum ore from platinum rocks. One platinum stone spirit will be used up for each additional platinum ore gained.
lead

Pneumatic gloves are melee gloves dropped by Automaton Tracers that can be found in the Guthixian temple after completing The World Wakes. When received with CoinShare active, the Pneumatic gloves will be dropped as 120 pneumatic gloves shards split evenly among the players and sent directly to their banks. 120 shards can be combined to create this item.
lead
The pogo stick is a fun weapon type device. Success in discovering the blueprint earns 121,584.7 Invention experience.
lead

A poison bomb is a bomb potion that can be thrown to create a 3x3 area for 6 seconds which applies poison to monsters standing in it. It can be made at level 99 Herblore in a bomb vial using primal extract, clean irit, poison slime, and a weapon poison++. At level 101 Herblore the recipe is improved, which reduces the time taken to make the bomb.
lead
The poison chalice is a green, sickly-looking beverage given out by the dwarf Stankers for free in his shop Stankers' Bronze Pickaxes, found at the Coal truck mine.
lead

Poison ivy berries are berries harvested from a poison ivy bush grown from a poison ivy seed planted in a bush patch, requiring level 70 Farming. Four poison ivy berries can be harvested from a bush patch at a time.
lead
Poison ivy seeds are seeds that can be grown with level 70 Farming. Poison ivy seeds may be bought from the Vinesweeper minigame for 30 Vinesweeper points each.
lead
Poison slime is a secondary Herblore ingredient obtained from frogs and venomous dinosaurs on the Ranch Out of Time.
lead

A poisoned egg is used in the final wave of Barbarian Assault. It is made by using a yellow egg, which is dropped by the Penance Queen in the 10th wave, on the poison crater. It must be passed on to the attacker to make a spiked & poisoned egg.
lead
Polar camo legs are a members only piece of polar camouflage gear. To make a pair, a player will need to bring two polar kebbit fur and 20 coins to the Fancy Clothes Store in Varrock.
lead
The polar camo top is a members only piece of the polar camouflage gear. To make one, bring two polar kebbit furs and 20 coins to the Fancy Clothes Store in south east Varrock.
lead

Polar kebbit fur is a reward for successfully tracking a polar kebbit and catching it with a noose wand, using the Hunter skill at level 1. They can also be obtained in Nyriki's polar kebbit portal with a box trap, requiring level 70 Hunter, and with polar kebbit quota tickets. Polar Kebbit fur may be used to make polar camouflage gear by taking two furs and 20 coins per piece to the Fancy Dress Store in south-east Varrock.
lead

Polaris is a companion pet that can be purchased for 10,000 oddments on a rotational basis in the Marketplace. It was originally unlocked by completing tier 30 of the Wintumber Aurora event with the premier pass.
lead
Given to you by Death during the 2020 Halloween event. It can be interacted with to give you a hint on where to find the location of the soul fragments.
lead
Pollnivneach Teleport scrolls are obtained from Treasure Trails, the amount depending on the difficulty of the clue. The scroll is destroyed when used and teleports the player to Pollnivneach.
lead

Polly is a main hand item that could be purchased from the Marketplace for 700 oddments before the rotating cosmetic stock update on 4 March 2024. It could also previously be obtained from the rare token store or the Oddments Store for 700 oddments.
lead
Polypore spores are dropped by all monsters in the Polypore Dungeon. 3,000 spores and 15,000 fire runes are used with a polypore stick to make a Polypore staff, requiring level 80 Farming to do so.
lead
The polypore staff is a degradable staff that requires level 75 Magic to wield. It is created by adding 3,000 polypore spores and 15,000 fire runes to a polypore stick.
lead
A polypore stick is a magical weapon which requires level 75 Magic to wield. It is dropped by ganodermic beasts in the Polypore Dungeon. The stick is needed to make a polypore staff.
lead

Poorly-cooked beast meat is a food item that can be made by using raw beast meat on a fire. The raw beast meat becomes 'poorly cooked' from being cooked on a fire rather than being cooked on a spit roast.
lead

Poorly-cooked bird meat is a food item that can be made by cooking raw bird meat directly on a fire or range. Members can add an iron spit to the raw bird meat to create skewered bird meat instead, which can be cooked into roast bird meat for more Cooking experience, although both heal the same amount.
lead

Porcelain clay is a material that players can obtain by mining porcelain clay rocks with level 102 Mining. Porcelain clay is obtained when mining the rocks in the mine that are not next to the water stream (otherwise soft porcelain clay is obtained).
lead
A pork pie can be made by using 3 pieces of cooked bacon with a pie shell and by cooking the resulting product: an uncooked pork pie, requiring 74 Cooking and giving 210 experience.
lead

lead

A portable brazier is a portable skilling station for Firemaking. When burning logs on it, a 10% base Firemaking experience boost is given, and there is a chance of 10% that the log will be saved while still granting full experience; this effect also applies when burning Protean logs.
lead

A portable crafter is a portable skilling station for Crafting. lead

A portable fletcher is a portable skilling station for Fletching. It lasts a total of 5 minutes after it is deployed; this duration can be extended by right-clicking additional portable fletchers in the backpack.
lead

The portable obelisk is a reusable item that teleports the player to a random Wilderness obelisk. If players attempt to operate a portable obelisk to enter the Wilderness while opted into PvP, they will receive a warning prompt about it before they can continue.
lead

A portable range is a portable skilling station that acts as a range when deployed. It could also be won from clover necklaces or obtained from portable skilling packs. If the bank is full, the extra food is dropped.
lead
A portable sawmill is a portable skilling station that acts likes sawmill operator when planted. The cost for making a plank with the sawmill is 10% lower than the cost from the sawmill operator.
lead
A Portable well is a portable skilling station for Herblore that also acts as an infinite supply of vials of water (empty vials are not required). A player can make any potion by clicking the well.
lead
The portable workbench is a portable skilling station that can be obtained from a portable skilling pack. Flatpacks generally take 8 ticks (4.8 seconds) to create.
lead

lead

A pot of flour is an item used mainly in the Cooking skill. Flour can be made into various types of dough by using it with a container filled with water or a water source, then used as an ingredient to make bread, pies, cakes, cheesecakes, pizzas, kebabs and biscuits. Raw blue blubber jellyfish is a type of fish that can only be caught at the Deep Sea Fishing Hub, which can be accessed by talking to Goomah in the Fishing Guild. Raw blue blubber jellyfish can be cooked into blue blubber jellyfish at level 95 Cooking giving 235 Cooking experience when successful.
lead
Raw calcified fungus soup is an uncooked calcified fungus soup, made by adding enriched calcified fungus to a bowl of water. It can be cooked on a range or a fire but may be burnt.
lead
Raw catfish is a type of fish that can be caught with level 60 Fishing in the Menaphos fishing spots, using a fishing rod and fishing bait.
lead

Raw cave eel is a fish that require level 38 Fishing to catch as well as a Cooking level of 38 to cook; doing so turns it into a cave eel. They can be caught with a fishing rod and bait. Raw cave eels are less likely to be caught from a fishing spot, as slimy eels have a higher drop rate and are caught at the same locations.

Raw cavefish are a type of fish that can be caught from cavefish shoals with 85 Fishing, found in the Living Rock Caverns underneath the Dwarven Mine, or in the Warforge with level 83 Archaeology (or 81 with a cup of soil tea), yielding 300 experience. Raw cavefish can be cooked into cavefish at level 88 Cooking for 214 Cooking experience.
lead

A raw chicken is an item that has two main uses: an uncooked food item and an ingredient in producing a dreadfowl pouch using the Summoning skill. Players can obtain one by killing a chicken or a rooster. Players can buy them from three shops: Rufus's Meat Emporium, Chargurr's Fresh Meat or Wydin's Food Store for 60 gp with a default stock of 30 for Canifis and 10 for the others respectively.
lead

A raw chompy is obtained by killing a chompy bird. It can be cooked on an iron spit or an ogre spit-roast at Rantz's house, to make cooked chompy. The ability to hunt chompies is unlocked during the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest.
lead

Raw claret crab is a type of fish that players can catch with at least level 56 Fishing, granting Fishing experience per catch. With at least level 56 Cooking, a raw claret crab can be cooked to gain 144 Cooking experience on a range and 158.4 over a fire. Claret crab are caught by using a lobster pot at a cage fishing spot.
lead
Raw cod is a fish that can be caught with a big net at any Net/Harpoon fishing spot. It can be cooked into cod with level 18 Cooking.
lead
Raw corbicula rex meat is an item obtained by hunting a corbicula rex. It can be cooked at level 81 Cooking to make corbicula rex meat.
lead
Raw crayfish is a fish caught from from a Cage fishing spot with a crayfish cage, requiring level 1 Fishing. Raw crayfish can be cooked into crayfish, requiring level 1 Cooking.
lead
Raw crunchies are the basis for all crunchies in Gnome cooking. They are created by using a Crunchy tray with Gianne dough.
lead
Raw desert sole is a type of fish that can be caught with level 52 Fishing in the Menaphos fishing spots, using a fishing rod and fishing bait.
lead
Raw fish pie is made by adding raw potato to a part fish pie (cod). It can then be cooked on a range which gives either a fish pie or a burnt pie.
lead
Raw fungal algae soup is an uncooked fungal algae soup, made by adding enriched fungal algae to a bowl of water. It can be cooked on a range or a fire but may be burnt.
lead
Raw fungal spore soup is an uncooked fungal spore soup, made by adding enriched fungal spores to a bowl of water. It can be cooked on a range, but may be burnt.
lead
Raw garden pie is made by adding cabbage to a part garden pie (onion). It can be cooked on a range to give either a garden pie or a burnt pie.
lead

Raw ghostly soles can be fished from the ghostly sole spot found in the City of Um graveyard with 66 Fishing using fishing bait and a fishing rod. It can be cooked into a ghostly sole at level 66 Cooking.
lead

Raw giant chinchompa meat is an uncooked food and Hunter bait. It can be cooked to get either giant chinchompa meat or apex sinew, or used to bait traps in Havenhythe Big Game Hunter to catch giant kebbits. It is obtained in small quantities with every successful hunt of a giant chinchompa.
lead

Raw giant crayfish is a fish caught from from a giant crayfish fishing spot with a lobster pot, requiring level 82 Fishing. They can be caught north of the Deserted Mine, in the pond next to the hut where Raz lives in Havenhythe, or from the Wendlewick fish farm activity. Raw giant crayfish can be cooked into giant crayfish, requiring level 86 Cooking.
lead

Raw giant kebbit meat is an uncooked food and Hunter bait. It can be cooked to get either giant kebbit meat or apex sinew, or used to bait traps to catch the giant volatile chinchompa and its higher-level variants. It is obtained in small quantities with every successful hunt of a giant kebbit during Havenhythe Big Game Hunter.
lead

Raw great white sharks can be fished at level 80 Fishing with a harpoon for 130 Fishing experience. They can be cooked at level 84 Cooking into a great white shark, which gives 212 Cooking experience and heal 2,100 life points. The perk can be unlocked at a Prawnbroker in a player-owned house.
lead

Raw green blubber jellyfish is a type of fish that can only be caught at the Deep Sea Fishing Hub, which can be accessed by talking to Goomah in the Fishing Guild. Raw green blubber jellyfish can be cooked into green blubber jellyfish at level 72 Cooking giving 165 Cooking experience when successful.
lead
Raw herring is a fish that can be caught by a player at level 10 Fishing, granting 30 Fishing experience. Raw herring can be cooked into herring at level 5 Cooking.
lead

Raw hogfish is a type of fish that players can catch with at least level 69 Fishing, or 89 Fishing and 69 Strength barehanded, granting 170 Fishing experience per catch. With at least level 69 Cooking, a raw hogfish can be cooked to gain 170 Cooking experience on a range and 187 over a fire. Hogfish are caught by using a harpoon at a harpoon fishing spot.
lead

A raw jubbly is obtained by killing a jubbly bird during, or after, the Recipe for Disaster quest (after having begun saving Skrach Uglogwee). It can be cooked with 41 Cooking on the ogre spit-roast located near Rantz or the one located at Jiggig.
lead

Raw karambwan is a cephalopod native to the tropical island of Karamja. A karambwan vessel is given to the player during the Tai Bwo Wannai Trio quest. The raw karambwanji bait is caught by using a small net in the lake south of Tai Bwo Wannai (Fairy ring CKR).
lead
A raw lobster is a type of fish that can be caught with level 40 Fishing, giving 90 experience. Raw lobsters can be cooked with a Cooking level of 40 or higher.
lead

Raw mackerel is a fish that can be caught with a big net at any Net/Harpoon fishing spot with level 16 Fishing, granting 20 Fishing experience. It can be cooked into mackerel with level 10 Cooking, and stop burning at level 45 Cooking. After completing In Aid of the Myreque quest, up to 10 raw mackerel can be purchased from Aurel's Supplies in Burgh de Rott for 26 coins.
lead

Raw malletops meat is an item obtained by hunting a malletops. It can be cooked at level 89 Cooking to make malletops meat. At level 99 Cooking, it can be cooked alongside raw pavosaurus rex meat, a red onion, and an heirloom tomato to make a primal main course.
lead
Raw manta ray is a members-only fish that requires level 81 Fishing to obtain. They can be received as a potential reward during the Fishing Trawler minigame.
lead
A raw minnow is a small fish that can be caught in a lake in western Ashdale or during the Davendale Tutorial in a designated fishing spot.
lead
Raw monkfish are members-only fish that can be caught at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony with a small fishing net with at least level 62 Fishing, granting 120 Fishing experience points per fish.
lead
Raw mud pie is made by adding clay to a part mud pie (water). It can be cooked on a range to give either a mud pie or a burnt pie.
lead

Raw oculi apoterrasaur meat is an item obtained by hunting an oculi apoterrasaur. It can be cooked at level 89 Cooking to make oculi apoterrasaur meat. At level 99 Cooking, it can be cooked alongside rainbow sweetcorn, cannonball cabbage, and sweet potato to make a primal starter.
lead

Raw oomlie may be obtained by killing the oomlie birds found in the Kharazi Jungle. At 50 Cooking, it can be wrapped in a palm leaf to get a wrapped oomlie, which can be cooked to get a cooked oomlie wrap. Wrapping it in a palm leaf is required to cook; the raw oomlie cannot be cooked on its own.
lead

Raw pavosaurus rex meat is an item obtained by hunting a pavosaurus rex. It can be cooked at level 89 Cooking to make pavosaurus rex meat. At level 99 Cooking, it can be cooked alongside raw malletops meat, red onion, and heirloom tomato to make a primal main course.
lead
Raw pawya meat can be obtained from the Hunter skill by box trapping pawya or from a divine box trap. Pawyas require 66 Hunter to catch and give 400 experience and can be found in Isafdar.
lead

Raw pike are fish that can be caught with level 25 Fishing, granting 60 Fishing experience per catch. It can be cooked into pike with level 20 Cooking. Raw pike are caught through bait fishing, which requires a fishing rod and fishing bait.
lead

A raw potato is a vegetable primarily used as an ingredient in Cooking. In addition, they can be harvested from a potato plant grown from 3 potato seeds in an allotment patch, requiring level 1 Farming. A minimum of three potatoes are harvested at a time.
lead

Raw rabbit is the meat of rabbits. It may be cooked or roasted, or added raw to make a Wild pie. The meat may be skewered on an iron spit to make skewered rabbit, which can then be roasted on a fire to make roasted rabbit.
lead

rows.h2: Wild rabbits may be found in Isafdar, Miscellania, and the Lumbridge Crater, they will drop this meat on death. Players may also find rabbits wandering around the Enchanted Valley (fairy code BKQ). White rabbits are found in Piscatoris and will drop raw rabbit meat (along with hunter-specific items)

rows: A raw rainbow fish is an item caught at level 38 Fishing, granting 80 Fishing experience. As salmon and trout can also be caught at fly fishing spots, the featherless fly fishing perk from the Pawnbroker additionally unlocks the ability to choose the type of fish you receive (changed under Construction options in Skills & Experience settings). Additionally, players may receive golden rainbow fish eggs while fishing, which can be placed into the Aquarium.
lead
Raw rat meat is an item usually obtained by killing a giant rat. It can be cooked on a range or on a fire. Raw rat meat can be bought from Rufus in Canifis and from Chargurr in Oo'glog.
lead

Raw rocktail is a fish caught from rocktail shoals, found in the Living Rock Caverns. Raw rocktails can be cooked into rocktails at level 93 Cooking for 225 Cooking experience, which are one of the highest healing one bite foods in the game. Rocktails require a normal fishing rod (in the inventory or tool belt) and living minerals as bait, which can be obtained by mining a living rock creature's remains or bought through the Grand Exchange.
lead

Raw sailfish is a type of fish that can only be caught in the north-east corner of the Deep Sea Fishing Hub. They can randomly be caught at the swarm fishing spot as early as 68 Fishing, although extremely rare (at 85 they tend to start appearing more often). Raw sailfish can be cooked at level 99 Cooking for 270 experience.
lead

Raw salmon are fish that can be caught with level 30 Fishing, granting 70 Fishing experience per catch. They are caught by using a fly fishing rod and feathers, with the lure option at Lure/Bait fishing spots found in rivers. In the more populated fishing spots where salmon and trout can be lured, free salmon and trout can be obtained from players training Fishing, who drop them to free up their inventories for faster Fishing xp.
lead

Raw sardines are fish that require level 5 Fishing to catch by using a normal fishing rod on a bait fishing spot, by the sea with fishing bait. Raw sardines may be cooked at level 1 Cooking to produce cooked sardines. In Creature Creation, a spidine is made from 1 red spiders' eggs and 1 raw sardine.
lead
Raw scimitops meat is an item obtained by hunting a scimitops. It can be cooked at level 75 Cooking to make scimitops meat.
lead

Raw sea turtle can be fished by members who have at least level 79 Fishing and can be cooked by members with at least level 82 Cooking. They can be received as a potential reward during the Fishing Trawler minigame, giving 38 Fishing experience per catch.
lead
Raw sharks can be fished by members who have level 76 Fishing or higher. Sharks give 110 Fishing experience per catch.
lead
Raw shrimps are, with a required Fishing level 1, the first fish that players can catch by using the small net on a net-fishing location. They can be cooked at Cooking level 1 to create Shrimps.
lead
Raw spicati apoterrasaur meat is an item obtained by hunting a spicati apoterrasaur. It can be cooked at level 81 Cooking to make spicati apoterrasaur meat.
lead

Raw summer pie is made by adding apple to a part summer pie (watermelon). It can be cooked on a range to give either a summer pie or a burnt pie. It requires level 95 Cooking to make and/or cook, giving the player 260 Cooking experience if successful.
lead
Raw swamp paste can be made by mixing a pot of flour with swamp tar, giving 1 Cooking experience. The resulting raw swamp paste can be cooked on a fire, giving 2 experience and swamp paste.
lead

A raw swordfish is a type of fish that players can catch with at least level 50 Fishing, or 70 Fishing and 50 Strength barehanded, granting 100 Fishing experience per catch with an additional 8 Strength experience per barehanded swordfish. With at least level 45 Cooking, a raw swordfish can be cooked to gain 140 Cooking experience on a range and 154 over a bonfire. Swordfish are caught by using a harpoon at a cage/harpoon fishing spot.
lead
Raw timber fungus soup is an uncooked timber fungus soup, made by adding enriched timber fungus to a bowl of water. It can be cooked on a range or a fire but may be burnt.
lead

Raw trout are fish that can be caught with level 20 Fishing, granting 50 Fishing experience per catch. It can be cooked into trout with level 15 Cooking. Raw trout are caught through fly fishing, which requires a fly fishing rod and feathers, with the lure option at Lure/Bait fishing spots found in rivers.
lead

Raw tuna are fish that can be caught with level 35 Fishing or level 55 Fishing if catching barehanded, granting 80 Fishing experience per catch. It can be cooked into tuna with level 30 Cooking, granting 100 Cooking experience on a range and 110 Cooking experience on a bonfire. Raw tuna are caught through harpooning, which requires either a harpoon or sufficient Barbarian Training.
lead

Raw turkey is an item that can be cooked into cooked turkey using the Cooking skill. It can be cooked by using it on a fire or range, granting 30 Cooking experience if successful, although there is a chance of producing burnt turkey instead. Players could obtain it as a possible drop from turkeys during the 2008 Thanksgiving event, Angry Turkeys during the 2011 Thanksgiving event, and during the 2012 Thanksgiving event and 2013 Thanksgiving event.
lead

Raw turkey drumstick is an item that can be cooked into a cooked turkey drumstick using the Cooking skill. It can be cooked by using it on a fire or range, granting 30 Cooking experience if successful, although there is a chance of producing a burnt turkey drumstick instead. Players could obtain it as a possible drop from wild turkeys during the 2008 Thanksgiving event and Angry Turkeys during the 2011 Thanksgiving event.
lead
Raw ugthanki meat is obtained after killing an ugthanki. Players can also use the meat to make a kebab mix, and ultimately, an ugthanki kebab.
lead

Raw undead beef is a raw food item that is a guaranteed drop from undead cows and zombie cows. Players can cook it at level 1 Cooking by using it on a range or a fire to make cooked undead meat, earning 30 Cooking experience per piece. Undead cows can only be found on Alice's farm west of Port Phasmatys, and zombie cows can only be found in New Varrock's cow pen.
lead

Raw undead chicken is an item obtained by killing undead chickens on the farm to the west of the Ectofuntus. Raw undead chicken cannot be used to create dreadfowl pouches or to access the Evil Chicken's Lair; both of these require regular raw chicken.
lead

A raw wild pie is made by adding raw rabbit to a part wild pie (raw chompy). It can be cooked on a range to produce either a wild pie or a burnt pie. To make a raw wild pie, players must (in order) add raw bear meat, raw chompy, and raw rabbit into a pie shell.
lead

A raw wilder pie is made by adding crushed dragonstone to a raw wild pie. It can be cooked on a range to produce either a wilder pie or a burnt pie. To make a raw wilder pie, players must (in order) add raw bear meat, raw chompy, raw rabbit, and crushed dragonstone into a pie shell.
lead

Raw wolf meat is a meat that is raw and can be cooked into Cooked meat, granting 30 Cooking experience. It can be obtained by killing all variations of wolves. It can also be cooked into sinew, granting 5 Cooking Experience.
lead

Raw yak meat can be obtained by killing a Yak on the Fremennik isle of Neitiznot. Players who paid Vanligga Gastfrihet's taxes in The Fremennik Isles quest can buy them from her for a price of 2 gp each.
lead
The razorback gauntlets are a pair of tier 90 melee power gloves. Upon death in the Wilderness, a fully charged pair of gloves will drop 25000 coins.
lead

A re-roll token (easy) can be redeemed for a re-roll of rewards from reward casket (easy). It can be purchased from the Treasure Trails Reward Shop for 30 points, or as a possible reward from a treasure trail.
lead

A re-roll token (elite) can be redeemed for a re-roll of rewards from reward casket (elite). It can be purchased from the Treasure Trails Reward Shop for 150 points, or as a possible reward from opening a reward casket (elite).
lead

A re-roll token (hard) can be redeemed for a re-roll of rewards from reward casket (hard). It can be purchased from the Treasure Trails Reward Shop for 100 points, or as a possible reward from a treasure trail.

A re-roll token (master) can be redeemed for a re-roll of rewards from reward casket (master). It is a possible reward from a master treasure trail; it cannot be purchased from Zaida.
lead

A re-roll token (medium) can be redeemed to re-roll rewards from a reward casket (medium). It can be purchased from the Treasure Trails Reward Shop for 50 points, or obtained as a possible reward from a treasure trail.
lead

A reaper necklace is an item that has a passive effect when worn: all successful hits give a 0.1% hit chance boost in all styles for 54 seconds, stacking up to 30 times (a total 3% hit chance increase); however, taking the necklace off or switching it for another item will cause the buff to disappear. The reaper necklace is created by casting the Lvl-6 Enchant spell on a hydrix necklace.

The reaper ornament kit is an ornament kit that may be obtained as a reward from opening master reward caskets. This may be used on a reaper necklace to create a reaper necklace (or).
lead

A reborn phoenix pouch is a summoning pouch used to summon a reborn phoenix. It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 173 spirit shards, a crimson charm, and 2 phoenix quill in the backpack, requiring 84 Summoning and giving 371.5 experience. It can be made into ten Phoenix scrolls (Rise From the Ashes) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 7.2 experience.

The red bead is a bead which is a drop from imps. Beads are used as optional bait in the box catching of imps, and can also be added to a tarromin potion (unfinished) to make a magic potion.
lead
The red blossom seed is used in the Herblore Habitat. They can be bought from Papa Mambo in the Herblore Habitat area.
lead
The red boater is a piece of headwear. To obtain a red boater, the player can either trade with another player or receive one as a medium Treasure Trail reward.
lead

The red cape is a reward from Nomad's Requiem quest. After the quest, players may purchase additional capes from Zimberfizz or Zanik for 150,000 coins per cape. Multiple capes can be obtained by dropping the capes a player already owns before buying a new one.
lead
The red cape is a cape worn only within the Soul Wars minigame. It is cosmetic until the completion of Nomad's Requiem quest, which gives the cape a 6 prayer bonus.
lead
The red cape is a cape worn only within the Soul Wars minigame. It is cosmetic until the completion of Nomad's Requiem quest, which gives the cape a 6 prayer bonus.
lead

Red chinchompas are multi-target stackable Ranged thrown weapons requiring level 55 Ranged to use. They can be obtained by using box trapping Hunter technique on carnivorous chinchompas in the Feldip Hunter area.
lead

A red dragon egg is an egg that can be obtained as a drop from adult red dragons. Players may receive more than one egg of each colour as long they don't have the respective colour dragon pet unlocked.
lead

A red dragon egg (unchecked) is the unchecked version of a red dragon from the player-owned farm. They are a very rare drop that can be obtained by killing red dragons. Though both a checked and unchecked dragon may be traded freely between players, only the unchecked variant can be sold on the Grand Exchange.
lead

A red dragon egg (unchecked) is the unchecked version of a red dragon from the player-owned farm. They are a very rare drop that can be obtained by killing red dragons. Though both a checked and unchecked dragon may be traded freely between players, only the unchecked variant can be sold on the Grand Exchange.
lead

Red dragon leather is used in the Crafting skill to make red dragonhide armour, awarding 78xp per piece of leather. It can be created by giving a red dragonhide and 20 coins to a tanner, or by using the Make Leather spell at level 83 Magic. Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Varrock, Taverley, Canifis and the Crafting Guild.
lead
A red dragon mask is a cosmetic mask available from opening hard reward caskets. It provides no stat bonuses.
lead

Red dragonhide (also called Red d'hide by tanners) is a 100% drop from red dragons when they die. Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Varrock, Taverley, Canifis, Prifddinas and the Crafting Guild. Members can then make red dragonhide armour from red dragon leather starting at level 55 Crafting.
lead

Red dragonhide body is red dragonhide armour worn in the torso slot available to member rangers. Members can also create red dragonhide body through the Crafting skill at level 55 from three pieces of red dragon leather, granting 234 Crafting experience.
lead
Red dragonhide boots are level 55 ranged tank boots. They can be created at level 55 Crafting with one red dragon leather, granting 78 Crafting experience.
lead

Red dragonhide chaps are red dragonhide armour worn in the legwear slot. Red dragonhide chaps are available to member rangers and require 55 Defence to wear. They can also be created by members through the Crafting skill at level 55 from two pieces of red dragon leather, giving 156 Crafting experience.
lead

The red dragonhide coif is a piece of Ranged armour worn in the headwear slot available to pay-to-play rangers, and requires 55 Defence in order to equip. At level 55 Crafting, players can create one using a needle, a spool of thread, and two pieces of red dragon leather, offering 156 Crafting experience.
lead

Red dragonhide set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.
lead

The red dragonhide shield is a shield used by rangers in combat. It can be made using the Crafting skill by using a needle and thread with four red dragon leather. It requires level 55 Crafting to make and rewards 312 Crafting experience.
lead

Red dragonhide vambraces are red dragonhide armour worn in the hand slot. Red dragonhide vambraces are available to member's rangers and require 55 Defence to wear. They can also be created by members through the Crafting skill at level 55 from one piece of red dragon leather, granting 78 Crafting experience.
lead

Red dye is a dye made from 3 redberries and giving 5 coins to Aggie in Draynor Village or by Rana the dyer in Pollnivneach. It can also be bought from Oronwen at Lletya Seamstress for 6 coins. Redberries can be found just below the south-eastern wall of Varrock.
lead

A red egg is used in Barbarian Assault to hurt penance monsters. If loaded into the egg launcher and shot at penance creatures, it will explode and deal heavy area of effect damage, up to 25% of maximum health on the main target, which can exceed 5,000.
lead
Red elegant blouse is a formal, fancy item of elegant clothing that can be obtained from easy clue scrolls.
lead
Red elegant legs is a formal, fancy item of elegant clothing that can be obtained from easy clue scrolls.
lead
Red elegant shirt is a formal, fancy item of elegant clothing that can be obtained from easy clue scrolls.
lead
A red elegant skirt is a formal, fancy item of elegant clothing that can be obtained from easy clue scrolls.
lead

Red envelope is an item involved with the Zodiac Training Treasure Hunter promotion. They could be obtained from Treasure Hunter or from healing Icxan, the wounded snake, during the Zodiac Training event.
lead

A red feather is an item which, along with all coloured feathers gathered from the Hunter skill, can be used in place of regular white feathers with the Fletching skill. Additionally, a red feather headdress can be created by adding 20 red feathers to a studded leather coif with level 79 Crafting. It is drop from the crimson swift bird caught using the Hunter skill.
lead

Red firelighter is a Treasure Trail reward, obtainable from any levelled clue scroll or from a fire spirit that appears while burning logs on a bonfire. These logs can be burnt, providing 50 Firemaking experience and creating a red flame.
lead
The red firework is an item added to the game on 17 December 2018, which is part of the Firework Festival promotion. It guarantees a red rarity prize when chosen.
lead
Red flowers are harvested after planting mithril seeds. Red flowers are also a possible reward from Soul Wars gambling.
lead

Red flowers is an item obtained within the minigame Trouble Brewing. Red flowers and blue flowers are found in the minigame for both the red and blue teams to collect. Team members must collect these coloured flowers in order to make coloured water, which is then used as an ingredient in the rum.
lead
A red headband is an item that can be worn in the head slot. It can be received as a medium Treasure Trails reward by opening a medium reward casket or from other players through trading.
lead
The red onion is a mega produce version of the onion. It is grown using regular onion seeds in allotment patches. Once it is active, red onions can be harvested.
lead

Red partyhat is an item that can be found on the ground at various locations around Gielinor. When the player attempts to pick one up, they receive a ring of rares instead accompanied with the message: You cast the partyhat aside and pick up a precious ring you find underneath it instead.
lead

The red salamander is the second strongest salamander and can be caught at 59 Hunter. It uses tarromin tar as ammo, which can be made by using a clean tarromin with swamp tar at 39 Herblore. It can also be bought from other players or at the Grand Exchange.
lead
A red salamander (unchecked) is the unchecked version of a red salamander. It is obtained from training at skilling stations in the Dream of Iaia.
lead

Red sandstone is the product of mining red sandstone rocks with level 81 Mining. It can be made into robust glass by using the robust glass machine or the Superglass Make spell. The water filtration system in Het's Oasis may collect red sandstone over time.
lead

rows.h2: Red sandstone can be mined in two locations: one near Oo'glog and another near Sophanem which is only available after completion of the elite Desert achievements.

rows: A red satchel is a drop from spidines in the Creature Creation activity. Other colours of satchels are available from the Creature Creation minigame.
lead

Red spiders' eggs are a secondary Herblore ingredient used to create a variety of potions. Red spiders' eggs are also used alongside raw sardines in the Creature Creation activity to create a spidine, which drops a number of red spiders' eggs when defeated.
lead

Red spiky vambraces are Red dragonhide vambraces with Kebbit claws attached, which doing so requires 32 Crafting and grants 5.8 Crafting experience. Red spiky vambraces can also be obtained by looting an Eclectic impling that has been caught.
lead

Red topaz is a type of semi-precious gem. It is obtained by cutting an uncut red topaz at level 16 Crafting, though there is a chance the player will accidentally destroy it in the process, turning it into a crushed gem; this chance decreases with a higher Crafting level. Successfully cutting an uncut red topaz grants the player 25 Crafting experience; if it is crushed, the player will only receive 6.3 Crafting experience.
lead
Red topaz bakriminel bolts are Bakriminel bolts with topaz bolt tips attached to them. Creating red topaz bakriminel bolts requires level 94 in Fletching, and grant 11.9 experience per bolt fletched.
lead
Red topaz bakriminel bolts (e) are red topaz bakriminel bolts that are enchanted via the Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Red topaz) spell by a player with level 94 Magic.
lead

The red topaz machete is the highest tier of machete available. It can be obtained by buying one from Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative, with a price of 2,000 trading sticks or by bringing 1,200 trading sticks, 3 uncut or cut red topaz and a gout tuber to Safta Doc in Tai Bwo Wannai village. Getting Safta Doc to create a red topaz machete will grant the That's Not a Knife... achievement which is part of the medium Karamja achievements.
lead
A red zodiac costume is an item involved with the Zodiac Training Treasure Hunter promotion. It is gained from prestiging the zodiac card three times.
lead

Redberries are berries harvested from a redberry bush planted in a bush patch, requiring level 10 Farming. 4 redberries can be harvested from a bush patch at a time. Players can also take 3 redberries and 5 coins to Aggie, or 3 redberries and 25 coins to Rana the dyer, to make red dye.
lead

A redberry pie is a type of pie that restores 250 life points in total, 2 bites each healing for 125. It can be obtained by baking an uncooked berry pie on a range, requiring level 10 Cooking and granting 78 experience when successful.
lead

A redberry pie is a type of pie that restores 250 life points in total, 2 bites each healing for 125. It can be obtained by baking an uncooked berry pie on a range, requiring level 10 Cooking and granting 78 experience when successful.
lead

Redberry seeds are seeds which can be planted and grown into redberries at level 10 Farming. The seed can be stolen from a Farmer (level 10 Thieving required) or obtained by killing monsters that drop redberry seeds. Redberry seeds may be bought from the Vinesweeper minigame for 5 points each.

If you do not have space in the backpack, you'll get the message: "You found a shard emanating magical energy as you were training, but there was no space in your inventory to take it." However, since talon beast charms are untradeable and difficult to obtain in bulk, they are less practical for Summoning training.

Tansymum can be picked from the plants west of Oo'glog. During and after the quest As a First Resort it can lit with a tinderbox to create smouldering tansymum which can be used to lure wimpy birds to capture them with a bird snare.

lead

lead

The tectonic mask is a tier 90 Magic power armour head slot item made at 91 Runecrafting using 14 tectonic energy and 1 stone of binding. Losing the tectonic mask by being killed in the Wilderness will result in a fraction of the original tectonic energy being dropped on death, based on how degraded it was, rounded down. For example, if the mask had 52% of its charges remaining, 7 tectonic energy would be dropped on death.
lead

For example, if the robe bottom had 52% of its charges remaining, 14 tectonic energy would be dropped on death.
lead
